document:
Checkout failures and elevated payment errors after the 14:02 payment-service deploy.
Symptoms: payment-service v2.3.1 deployed; config change payment_timeout_ms 2000 -> 200; checkout p99 latency rose 800ms -> 4.2s; checkout error rate 0.1% -> 5.3%
Root cause: config_timeout_drop
Action items: review config change for config_timeout_drop

API latency spikes and cache hit-rate collapse after redis node maintenance.
Symptoms: redis maxmemory lowered 8GB -> 2GB during maintenance; cache hit-rate 96% -> 41%; API p95 latency 120ms -> 900ms
Root cause: redis_cache_eviction
Action items: review config change for redis_cache_eviction

Order processing stalled; consumers lagging after a Kafka partition rebalance.
Symptoms: orders-consumer v1.9 rolled out with session.timeout.ms 30s -> 5s; consumer lag 0 -> 4.5M messages; Rebalance failed: MemberId required for session.timeout 5s < processing time
Root cause: kafka_consumer_lag
Action items: review config change for kafka_consumer_lag
